result.title: Test-Time Selective Adaptation for Cross-Modal UAV Object Tracking with Token Shift
result.summary: Cross-modal unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object tracking faces modality-induced appearance discrepancies and abrupt target-position shifts that can arise from modality switching, UAV motion, and inter-sensor offsets. Although existing methods model modality and spatial variations, they primarily rely on offline representation learning and offer limited localization-oriented adaptation during testing. To address these challenges, we propose Test-Time Selective Adaptation with Token Shift (TSAT), which derives spatial and temporal adaptation signals from unlabeled test sequences for online optimization. Specifically, we design a controllable token shift auxiliary task, which imposes explicit spatial correspondence between predefined token translations and resultant localization offsets, generating stable annotation-free spatial adaptation signals. Furthermore, we introduce a temporal backward prediction auxiliary task to exploit frame-wise temporal dependencies, effectively mitigating cumulative localization errors in continuous tracking. To suppress interference from unreliable tracking samples, we develop a reliability-aware update gating strategy to screen valid adaptation signals and stabilize online parameter updates. Experiments on CM-UOT demonstrate that TSAT achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing test-time adaptation methods, exhibiting superior robustness under frequent modality switching and severe spatial displacement. Experiments across tracking frameworks and datasets further validate the effectiveness and generalization capability of TSAT.

AI.brief_summary: 针对跨模态无人机目标跟踪中的模态外观差异与目标位置突变，提出测试时选择性适应方法 TSAT：以可控 token 平移辅助任务和无标注序列上的时间反向预测产生空间、时间适应信号，并用可靠性感知的门控策略筛选样本、稳定在线参数更新。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「token 平移—定位偏移」显式对应约束可能可供核查视觉 token 内部状态是否保留空间几何信息，基于可靠性的在线更新门控也为「证据筛选与适应信号贡献分配」提供方法线索；但该文面向跟踪定位而非多模态推理，无 latent 推理环节。
